description: Admission policy sweep on matched traces, on the REFITTED measured cost curve. Baseline is stock (=promote). Supersedes the 2026-08-09 sweep, whose cost model failed its hardware holdout at 105.7% MAPE.
note_rates: Regridded 2026-08-10. The old grid topped out at 90 req/s because the old cost model put stock capacity near 49 req/s. The refitted curve gives a best 7.14 ms/request, so saturation is near 140 req/s and the old grid sat ENTIRELY below the knee -- it could not have observed the effect vanishing under load, which was one of that sweep's headline claims. Extended to 180 to span it.
note_model: Was Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which no run ever used. Every measurement behind this sweep is Qwen3-4B on v5litepod-4; the config now says so.
note_overhead: Simulated with client_overhead_s=0, i.e. what the policy costs intrinsically. e40's hardware numbers carry ~24 ms/dispatch of harness overhead, which enlarges batches for every policy and helps stock most, so the measured saving is a lower bound on this.
